title: The 422 cli-refused answer of any route
description: The error envelope of spec-004 §5 for a refusal of the project's WingFoil CLI (exit 1, REQ-INT-04): message is the CLI's message, local folders and URL userinfo redacted and unsafe characters escaped, at most 4 000 characters; from v0.3, detail.reasons holds the detail texts of a WingFoil 0.3.x refusal's details (spec-001 §2, W-20; task-070), each sanitised like the message, at most 200 then one line counting the others — present only when there is one, so a refusal without details (WingFoil 0.2.2) has no detail. The details' file names are not passed on. The ingestion's partial-failure detail (created, commits) is v0.4's (G5 moved, RP3-7) and not in this schema.
